_readme: Waivers for overrides that intentionally drop a member upstream declares.
`npm run verify:patches` flags any override whose output lacks a member the
unpatched output declares (REMOVES-MEMBER). Most such findings are defects:
deleting a real member is how omnibox.SuggestResult nearly lost `deletable`.
A waiver says the loss is deliberate and records why, with evidence that can
be re-checked against a pinned source.
Every entry below was verified on 2026-08-15 against the Gecko schema at tag
143.0.0 is generated from. In each case the member carries "unsupported":
true in Firefox's own schema, upstream annotates it @deprecated Unsupported
on Firefox, and BCD either records version_added: false or has no entry.
Dropping them from the merged surface is therefore correct, not a defect.
A waiver is not permanent. Re-verify when the pinned upstream version
changes: a member Firefox later implements must lose its waiver.

verified.method: Gecko schema property carries "unsupported": true; cross-checked against BCD

waivers.evidence: web_navigation.json@FIREFOX_143_0_RELEASE onErrorOccurred.processId and .error both have "unsupported": true

devtools_inspected_window.json@FIREFOX_143_0_RELEASE eval options: all three have "unsupported": true
omnibox.json@FIREFOX_143_0_RELEASE type SuggestResult: both have "unsupported": true. Note `deletable` is NOT waived and must stay (BCD firefox 109).
omnibox.json@FIREFOX_143_0_RELEASE type DefaultSuggestResult: both have "unsupported": true
